package.description: A per-process network monitor with a terminal UI and headless JSON mode.

en-US.description: A per-process network monitor with a terminal UI and headless JSON mode.
en-US.longDescription:
RustNet shows live TCP, UDP, and QUIC connections with per-process attribution.
Npcap must be installed separately for live capture. Default Npcap
installation settings are supported. --help and --version work without Npcap.
en-US.name: RustNet
